query: The group has long described their pre-dawn meet at the trailhead on race-prep days as the standard. Does this convention apply to everyone? If not, name one member who pushes against it and what they actually prefer.
gold: No, the convention does not apply to everyone. Sonia is one clear exception: when the meet-time was reopened, she said flatly that "some of us are not running pre-dawn" and that she would catch up at the trailhead breakfast at 8:30am, framing it as a fact about her, "i didn't join a running club to wake up at 5am every saturday." The same exchange surfaces Iris and Marcus pushing back on the same convention, leading the group to formalize a 6:12am wave and a 7:30am wave instead of one universal pre-dawn meet.
context:
[1] (about=Sonia, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:33:00) 🙃🙃🙃 some of us are not running pre-dawn, sorry team. i'll catch up at the trailhead breakfast at 8:30am. no early start for me ever. i didn't join a running club to wake up at 5am every saturday, that is a fact 🥂
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:22:00) ugh. ok. crew, we are NOT doing 5:30am again this year. last year killed me. can we make this 6:30am soft start, sunrise plus zero, instead?
[3] (about=Iris, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:35:00) yeah honestly i don't think i can do pre-sunrise either... like the birds aren't even up yet?? that's literally when the dawn chorus STARTS, you can't bird before dawn lol. i'll do my own thing for early starts, sorry
[4] (about=Beatrix, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:42:00) I notice that the early-start convention has always been written as universal, but we have at least three people right now saying it does not work for them. Maybe it has never quite been universal. Worth flagging.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:48:00) ok proposal: 6:12am meet for the sunrise crowd, 7:30am meet for the second wave. same trail, second group catches up at the first water stop. Greg and I will lead the second wave. all good?
[6] (about=Bernard, episodic, t9 @2026-03-09T07:15:00) Group reminder: the spring race-prep series begins Saturday. Per long-standing convention, we meet at the trailhead thirty minutes before sunrise. Sunrise on Saturday is 6:42am, so meet time is 6:12am.
[7] (about=Theo, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:40:00) Pre-dawn meet is operationally correct. I will be there at six.
[8] (about=Bernard, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:25:00) Marcus, with respect, the convention exists for a reason: light at the trailhead is poor before sunrise, and the warmup proper begins at sunrise itself. Moving the meet forty minutes later changes the entire structure.
[9] (about=Bernard, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T07:45:00) Beatrix, fair point. The convention has held because the alternative is logistical chaos. One is open to a two-meet system if there are volunteers to coordinate it.
[10] (about=Cyrus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-09T08:11:00) Team, I will set up coffee and pastries at the trailhead at 7am for the second wave. Black coffee for those who want it.
agent_answer:
No — the convention does not apply to everyone. Multiple members push against the pre-dawn meet.

One clear example: **Sonia** refuses pre-dawn starts entirely. She prefers to skip the early run and will catch up at the trailhead breakfast at **8:30am**, saying she didn't join a running club to wake up at 5am.

(Others who also resist it: Marcus proposed a **6:30am soft start** or a **7:30am second wave**, and Iris said she can't do pre-sunrise and will do her own thing for early starts.)

query: The group treats the post-outing brewery stop at Hawthorne's as the default plan after long days out. Does this default actually apply to everyone? If not, name one member who quietly opts out and what they prefer instead.
gold: No, the default does not apply to everyone. Owen quietly opts out: when Sonia named the brewery as the default after the maintenance day, Owen replied "Brewery pass." In his voice that two-word reply is decisive, and the same conversation surfaces Bernard and Ana also stepping out. Owen's actual preference, made visible across the corpus, is to go straight from trail work into off-trail scouting or home, not to a social bar setting.

agent_answer: No — the default does not apply to everyone. Several members quietly opt out. For example, **Bernard** opts out and prefers to **head home directly** instead of going to Hawthorne's. (Others include Ana, who skips due to a school board call and prefers to wrap up and get back; Lionel and Beatrix, who prefer a slow walk home; and Owen, who just passes.)
